config.title: Storage
config.description: Physical storage used and available across all clusters, as of the end of the timeframe

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT "clusterName", AVG("storageUsedTiB") AS "used", AVG("storageCapacityTiB") AS "capacity" FROM "perf" GROUP BY 1) SELECT SUM("used") AS "used", SUM("capacity") AS "capacity", 100.0 * SUM("used") / NULLIF(SUM("capacity"), 0) AS "usedPercent" FROM c

config.title: vCPU Allocation
config.description: vCPUs given to powered-on VMs against the physical cores in every host. Above 3 per core deserves a look

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT SUM("cpuCores") AS "cores", SUM("memoryGiB") AS "hostMemory" FROM "hosts"), v AS (SELECT SUM("vCpus") AS "vcpus", SUM("memoryGiB") AS "vmMemory" FROM "vms" WHERE "powerState[Expanded].rawState" = 'ON') SELECT COALESCE(v."vcpus", 0) AS "vcpus", h."cores", 1.0 * COALESCE(v."vcpus", 0) / NULLIF(h."cores", 0) AS "cpuRatio", COALESCE(v."vmMemory", 0) AS "vmMemory", h."hostMemory", 100.0 * COALESCE(v."vmMemory", 0) / NULLIF(h."hostMemory", 0) AS "memoryAllocated" FROM h, v

config.title: Memory Allocation
config.description: Memory given to powered-on VMs against the physical memory in every host

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT SUM("cpuCores") AS "cores", SUM("memoryGiB") AS "hostMemory" FROM "hosts"), v AS (SELECT SUM("vCpus") AS "vcpus", SUM("memoryGiB") AS "vmMemory" FROM "vms" WHERE "powerState[Expanded].rawState" = 'ON') SELECT COALESCE(v."vcpus", 0) AS "vcpus", h."cores", 1.0 * COALESCE(v."vcpus", 0) / NULLIF(h."cores", 0) AS "cpuRatio", COALESCE(v."vmMemory", 0) AS "vmMemory", h."hostMemory", 100.0 * COALESCE(v."vmMemory", 0) / NULLIF(h."hostMemory", 0) AS "memoryAllocated" FROM h, v

config.title: Allocation by Cluster
config.description: Over-commit per cluster: vCPUs and memory given to powered-on VMs against the physical cores and memory of its hosts

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT "clusterName" AS "cluster", COUNT(*) AS "hosts", SUM("cpuCores") AS "cores", SUM("memoryGiB") AS "hostMemory" FROM "hosts" GROUP BY 1), v AS (SELECT "clusterName" AS "cluster", COUNT(*) AS "vms", SUM("vCpus") AS "vcpus", SUM("memoryGiB") AS "vmMemory" FROM "vms" WHERE "powerState[Expanded].rawState" = 'ON' GROUP BY 1) SELECT h."cluster", h."hosts", COALESCE(v."vms", 0) AS "vms", h."cores", COALESCE(v."vcpus", 0) AS "vcpus", 1.0 * COALESCE(v."vcpus", 0) / NULLIF(h."cores", 0) AS "cpuRatio", h."hostMemory", COALESCE(v."vmMemory", 0) AS "vmMemory", 100.0 * COALESCE(v."vmMemory", 0) / NULLIF(h."hostMemory", 0) AS "memoryAllocated" FROM h LEFT JOIN v ON v."cluster" = h."cluster" ORDER BY "cpuRatio" DESC

config.title: vCPUs vs Physical Cores
config.description: vCPUs allocated to powered-on VMs beside the physical cores available, per cluster

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT "clusterName" AS "cluster", COUNT(*) AS "hosts", SUM("cpuCores") AS "cores", SUM("memoryGiB") AS "hostMemory" FROM "hosts" GROUP BY 1), v AS (SELECT "clusterName" AS "cluster", COUNT(*) AS "vms", SUM("vCpus") AS "vcpus", SUM("memoryGiB") AS "vmMemory" FROM "vms" WHERE "powerState[Expanded].rawState" = 'ON' GROUP BY 1) SELECT h."cluster", h."hosts", COALESCE(v."vms", 0) AS "vms", h."cores", COALESCE(v."vcpus", 0) AS "vcpus", 1.0 * COALESCE(v."vcpus", 0) / NULLIF(h."cores", 0) AS "cpuRatio", h."hostMemory", COALESCE(v."vmMemory", 0) AS "vmMemory", 100.0 * COALESCE(v."vmMemory", 0) / NULLIF(h."hostMemory", 0) AS "memoryAllocated" FROM h LEFT JOIN v ON v."cluster" = h."cluster" ORDER BY "cpuRatio" DESC

config.title: VM Memory vs Physical Memory
config.description: Memory allocated to powered-on VMs beside the physical memory of the hosts, per cluster (GiB)

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT "clusterName" AS "cluster", COUNT(*) AS "hosts", SUM("cpuCores") AS "cores", SUM("memoryGiB") AS "hostMemory" FROM "hosts" GROUP BY 1), v AS (SELECT "clusterName" AS "cluster", COUNT(*) AS "vms", SUM("vCpus") AS "vcpus", SUM("memoryGiB") AS "vmMemory" FROM "vms" WHERE "powerState[Expanded].rawState" = 'ON' GROUP BY 1) SELECT h."cluster", h."hosts", COALESCE(v."vms", 0) AS "vms", h."cores", COALESCE(v."vcpus", 0) AS "vcpus", 1.0 * COALESCE(v."vcpus", 0) / NULLIF(h."cores", 0) AS "cpuRatio", h."hostMemory", COALESCE(v."vmMemory", 0) AS "vmMemory", 100.0 * COALESCE(v."vmMemory", 0) / NULLIF(h."hostMemory", 0) AS "memoryAllocated" FROM h LEFT JOIN v ON v."cluster" = h."cluster" ORDER BY "cpuRatio" DESC
